headline: AI/ML Engineer | Open Source Contributor |Software Engineer
summary: Computer Science undergraduate specializing in machine learning, computer vision, and Linux-based network systems. Experienced in building end-to-end ML pipelines, from data collection to real-time deployment, and testing 4G/5G network architectures through open-source infrastructure projects.

experience.title: LFX Mentee
experience.summary: Contributed to Magma Core, an open-source 4G/5G mobile network platform, as part of the Linux Foundation's LFX Mentorship program.
achievements: Deployed and configured Magma using Docker and Linux virtual machines to simulate mobile network infrastructure
Tested network registration and session flows using Wireshark, UERANSIM, and PacketRusher to validate 4G/5G functionality
Collaborated with mentors via GitHub and Slack to understand and contribute to Magma's microservices architecture

projects.name: palm-pop
projects.description: a real-time computer vision pipeline that maps webcam hand gesture detection to keyboard input for gameplay control.
highlights: Trained and benchmarked YOLOv8n/s via transfer learning for 3-class hand gesture detection, achieving 99.4% mAP@50 and 97.7% recall on a custom 394-image dataset
Built a real-time CV pipeline mapping webcam gesture detection to keyboard input using priority-based action resolution and cooldown logic
Built a reproducible data pipeline with fixed-seed train/val splits and benchmarked model size vs. speed/accuracy tradeoffs to select the optimal deployment model

projects.name: pink-soc
projects.description: a two-stage cyberattack detection and response agent that classifies network traffic into 15 attack types and automates a response action for each flow.
highlights: Classifies network traffic into 15 attack types (DDoS, Port Scan, SQL Injection, etc.) and automates a response action (Allow, Block, Alert, Isolate) for each flow
Trained an XGBoost classifier on the CICIDS2017 dataset (2.27M+ traffic records across 8 days), achieving 99.64% test accuracy
Applied the full ML lifecycle end-to-end — preprocessing an imbalanced real-world security dataset, reinforcement learning, and deployment as a working Gradio app

projects.name: its-giving-hire
projects.description: An AI-powered resume screening tool that uses agentic AI to evaluate and shortlist candidates automatically.
highlights: Built an agentic pipeline that screens resumes against job criteria using Groq-hosted LLMs for fast inference
Designed to automate a traditionally manual first-pass hiring step, reducing recruiter screening time

projects.name: phantom-fill
projects.description: A browser automation tool that silently fills and submits Google Forms multiple times — set it, forget it, vanish.
highlights: Automated repeated Google Form submissions using Selenium-driven browser scripting
Built for hands-off, headless execution with minimal user intervention once configured

projects.name: numpie
projects.description: An ASCII art generator that converts images into text-based art using NumPy for pixel-level processing.
highlights: Used NumPy array operations to map image pixel intensity to ASCII character sets
Built as a from-scratch exploration of image processing fundamentals without relying on higher-level CV libraries

projects.name: serve
projects.description: My first built-from-scratch game — a playable project made while learning Godot game development.
highlights: Designed and shipped a complete playable game loop using the Godot engine
First end-to-end game dev project — covered scene management, input handling, and game logic in GDScript

projects.name: brainless-game-jam
projects.description: A game jam entry built under time constraints in Godot, focused on rapid prototyping and creative constraint-driven design.
highlights: Built and shipped a playable prototype within a fixed game jam timeframe
Practiced fast iteration and scope management under time pressure

open_source_contributions.description: Contributed documentation for the Ditto config provider plugin in WinHome, a declarative Infrastructure-as-Code tool for Windows dev environments, as part of GirlScript Summer of Code 2026.
contributions: Authored documentation for the Ditto config provider plugin, closing issue #446 (PR #475, merged)

open_source_contributions.description: Fixed a bug in OAIEDU's Discord Quiz Bot where the /rank command crashed for the student role when no leaderboard data existed.
contributions: Fixed /rank command failure when no users were registered, replacing the crash with a proper fallback message (PR #39, merged, closing issue #35)
